structural_change: SQK-INGEST 10-21 (SAFE-QK; SAFE-AUDIT-KV item 5): qkd_hr_ingest_qm successor with the CDC FIFO payload in SRAM. rtl/qwen_sys/host_cluster_cdc_20261018/qkd_hr_native_qm_cdc.sv: u_hx (16x514) and u_ox (16x289) payload in ot_sram_1r1w2c_32x546_m1_p192_mir u_hxm / u_oxm (16 of 32 rows), Gray pointers stay the reviewed 1-bit ot_link_afifo, macro read address = next read pointer so the head is first-word fall-through on the same edge (cycle-exact vs the flop fork: rtl/test/qwen_host/qm_sram_1021 8/8 configs, mutant FAILS); u_rx absent at RMW_EN 0; data-only registers unreset; per-domain reset synchronisers = reviewed ot_host_reset_bank (16/4/4 KEPT leaves) spread <= 32 loads by reset_relay_split. Ports, pins (W face) and the static schedule unchanged (0 cycles). FALLBACK (larger outline): 648x518.4 (15x12); W band 84 um for pin regs + the I0/payload registers next to both macros' rd_out/wd_in faces (both R0), 98.8 um std band between them, 82 um band to the engine; 32 qm-bank macros 4x8 at 73.4 x 59.4 pitch. Previous flop-FIFO kit (c3, 5c053111c) never left synth_odb (2.2M OT_GF storage pairs).
